simple.summary: תַּחַשׁ (Tachash) means Tachash , a relative of Abraham First listed occurrence: Gen 22 24.

definitions.full: H8477. Tachash II. תַּ֫חַשׁ proper name, masculine 'son' of Nahor Gen 22:24 ; Τοχος ; identification by Wkl Mitth. d. Vorderas. Gesellsch. 1896, 207 with T£—esï (Egyptian), which WMM As.u.Eur.258 puts north of Kadesh on Orontes.
